programme.title: Golmaal Returns
programme.desc: Gopal’s life hits choppy waters when he gets stuck on a yacht for a night upon rescuing an attractive young woman by fighting off some goons. Now, he has his wife suspecting him of having an affair and a police officer on his tail.

programme.title: Charanon Ki Saugandh
programme.desc: Ravi (Mithun Chakraborty) is the son of a poor farmer forced to work as a servant for a powerful local landowner (Prem Chopra). During the village elections, Ravi decides to take a stand by running against the wealthy tyrant, thus inviting the landowner's wrath in the process.

programme.title: Dance Dance
programme.desc: Two siblings Radha (Smita Patil) and Ramu (Mithun Chakraborty) emerge from poverty and become popular performers, that is, until tragedy strikes them. 'Dance Dance' is the journey of Ramu who vows to take revenge against the man who exploited his mother, murdered his father and tortured his sister.

programme.title: Fiffty Fiffty
programme.desc: Bihari's (Om Shivpuri) father loses his ancestral estate to Virendra Singh's (Ranjeet) family, who now live on the land in a palatial house. Singh has a son named Kishan (Rajesh Khanna). Bihari feels that they do not deserve the riches and sets out to swap his own infant son with Kishan. An attempt to stop him is made by Virendra, who gets killed. Bihari's wife tries to stop her husband but is unable to do so. Bihari thus manages to hide the truth from everyone. He hands over Kishan to his brother in Mumbai and introduces him to the life of crime, then watches as his own son grows up surrounded by riches. Will they ever find the truth about their lineage?
